answer: The relic register is checked at draw time, canyon lists the eligible set, and reef seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 59 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 59 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 320 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
